items.question: How do I enroll in a course?
items.answer: Simply browse our course catalog, choose the course that fits your goals, and click 'Enroll Now.' You can pay securely online and get instant access to start learning right away.

items.question: Are the courses self-paced or scheduled?
items.answer: We offer both! Most of our pre-recorded courses are completely self-paced. For live classes and tuition sessions, you'll choose a schedule that works with your calendar.

items.question: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
items.answer: Yes! Every course comes with a verified digital certificate upon completion. You can share it on LinkedIn, add it to your resume, or download it as a PDF.

items.question: Can I access course materials after the course ends?
items.answer: Absolutely. Once you enroll, you get lifetime access to all course materials including videos, notes, quizzes, and downloadable resources.

items.question: How do live tuition sessions work?
items.answer: Our live sessions connect you with expert tutors via video call. You can book 1-on-1 or small group sessions. Each session is interactive with real-time Q&A and screen sharing.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and popular wallets. International students can pay via PayPal. EMI options are also available on select courses.

items.question: Do you offer a refund policy?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on all courses. If you're not satisfied within the first 7 days, simply request a refund. No questions asked.

items.question: Are there any free courses or trials?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a selection of free introductory courses across all categories. Plus, most paid courses include a free preview of the first few lessons.

items.question: What devices can I use to access courses?
items.answer: Learn on any device, laptop, tablet, or smartphone. Our platform is fully responsive and works on all modern browsers with offline download support.

items.question: How do I contact customer support?
items.answer: You can reach us via email, phone, or the live chat on our website. We also have a Contact Us page where you can submit a detailed message. Average response time is under 2 hours.

content.headline: Privacy
content.description: Your privacy is our highest priority. Here's how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: Your privacy is our highest priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our applications, websites, and services. We are committed to ensuring that your data remains secure and is used exclusively to provide and enhance your experience. By using our Services, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Applicability of this Policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy applies to all data collected through our Services. It governs how your data is processed, stored, and managed. Please note that this policy is limited to our operations and does not cover third-party websites or services that may be linked to our Services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: We only collect information necessary to provide you with access to our Services. This includes personal information (name, email, phone number) for account registration, usage information (features used, device info, IP address), and any feedback or suggestions you provide. We do not collect sensitive personal data such as financial information, health data, or biometric data.

sections.title: Use of Your Information
sections.body: We use your information solely to: provide access to our Services and ensure smooth operation, personalize your experience and deliver relevant content, respond to your inquiries and provide customer support, and improve our Services through feedback and usage analytics. We do not share your data with third parties under any circumstances.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. This includes encryption of all data during transmission and storage, regular security audits and vulnerability scans, and secure servers protected by firewalls. While we take every precaution, no system is completely foolproof. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.

sections.title: Data Retention & Deletion
sections.body: Your data is retained for as long as your account remains active. Upon receiving a deletion request, your account will be marked for deletion and permanently removed after 30 days. Residual data such as backups and system logs will be securely purged within 30 days. You can delete your account from your profile settings or contact us to request deletion.

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
sections.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance functionality and performance, and to provide a seamless user experience by remembering your preferences. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect some features. We do not use cookies for advertising or tracking purposes, and no data collected via cookies is shared with third parties.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: As a user, you have the right to: access a copy of your data, correct inaccurate or incomplete information, permanently delete your account and all associated data, object to processing for specific purposes, and request your data in a machine-readable format (data portability). To exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not share, sell, rent, or disclose your personal data to any third party under any circumstances. Your data is used solely within our platform for purposes directly related to the operation and improvement of our Services.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our Services are intended for users aged 18 and above. If you are under 18, you may use our Services only with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. If we become aware of any data collected from a minor without proper consent, we will delete it immediately.

sections.title: Updates to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or to comply with legal requirements. Any updates will be posted on this page, and we recommend reviewing the policy regularly. If you have questions about this policy, feel free to contact us, we're happy to help.
